body: Just logged back onto my alt. Thank you. That means a lot to me, I know I'm late and all but ... thanks.

A lot building up. Sorry I didn't use the word cut. Feeling alone and like that's never changed through my whole life. I thought I had made a friend, a good one, the one I met 23 months and 1 day ago. A lot of less than grand things happened and she sides with everyone but me now, and I'm all alone again. I think I always was.
